top_signals.title: Quest for Evergrande Cash Spans Stashed Artwork, Jet Sale
top_signals.summary: Nearly three years after China Evergrande Group began winding up, liquidators have recovered less than 1% of the $46 billion sought by creditors, which they aim to begin distributing in the first half of 2027.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: JPMorgan says crypto regulatory moves partly offset Clarity Act failure, but risks remain
top_signals.summary: JPMorgan said actions by U.S. regulators partly offset the Clarity Act setback, but longer-lasting rules are still needed.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Lewis Hamilton hints at extending career in order to realize ‘dream’ of racing in Africa
top_signals.summary: The Ferrari driver will be 42 in January and has a contract for 2027. Fernando Alonso, the oldest active F1 driver, is 45 and recently signed up for another season.
